0.headline: Coca-Cola is said to consider December filing for India unit’s $1 billion IPO
0.heading: Coca-Cola is said to consider December filing for India unit’s $1 billion IPO
0.intro: The IPO is expected to consist largely of shares sold by existing investors, with Coca-Cola seeking a valuation of about $10 billion
0.body:
Coca-Cola Co. is considering filing a draft prospectus in December for an initial public offering of its Indian bottling unit, according to people familiar with the matter.

The Atlanta-based drinks giant has also added Axis Capital Ltd. and IIFL Capital Services Ltd. to the roster of banks working on the Hindustan Coca-Cola Beverages Pvt deal, the people said, asking not to be identified because the deliberations are private.

The IPO is expected to consist largely of shares sold by existing investors, with Coca-Cola seeking a valuation of about $10 billion, the people said. Bloomberg News has reported previously that the IPO could raise around $1 billion.

Deliberations are ongoing, so details including the timing, valuation and structure of the offering may change. Representatives for Coca-Cola and the banks didn’t immediately respond to requests for comment.

Coca-Cola is also working with Kotak Mahindra Capital Co., Citigroup Inc., JPMorgan Chase &amp; Co. and Morgan Stanley on the IPO, local media has reported.

A listing would help Coca-Cola tap strong investor demand for new offerings in India, while unlocking value from one of the country’s largest bottling operations. Proceeds from IPOs in India have reached almost $10 billion in July-September — the most ever for the quarter — thanks to blockbuster offerings by National Stock Exchange of India Ltd. and SBI Funds Management Ltd. The country is now on track for one of its best years ever, with over $13 billion raised already in nearly 250 IPOs, data compiled by Bloomberg show.

1.headline: SME IPO: EverestIMS Tech issue booked 31% on Day 2 so far - Check GMP, other key details
1.heading: SME IPO: EverestIMS Tech issue booked 31% on Day 2 so far - Check GMP, other key details
1.intro: SME segment is seeing multiple IPOs, with as many as eight issues opening for subscription on September 30.
1.body:
The initial public offering (IPO) of EverestIMS Tech was subscribed 31 percent on the second day of the share sale on Wednesday.

The Rs 48.46 crore BSE SME issue opened for subscription on September 29 and will close on October 5. The shares are scheduled to be listed on October 8.

According to platforms tracking grey market activities, shares of EverestIMS Tech are commanding a grey market premium (GMP) of 21-24 percent.

Investorgain quoted a GMP of Rs 20 for the shares, indicating a listing gain of 23.53 percent. IPO Watch quoted a GMP of 21.18 percent.
Check All IPO News
Incorporated in 2017, the company is a Bangalore-based software company offering software-as-a-service (SaaS) and on-premises IT Operation and Service Management (ITOSM) solutions under the brand 'Infraon'.

Its flagship platform, 'Infraon Infinity', provides AI-enabled capabilities including AIOps, ITSM, ITIM, NCCM, ITAM and OSS. The company serves enterprises, telecom operators and small and medium-sized businesses across India, the UAE, Malaysia and other international markets.

Meanwhile, the SME segment is witnessing multiple IPOs, with eight issues opening for subscription on Wednesday.

The other issues are Omara Ventures India, Sollfege Smart Electronics, Eventions, Acme India Industries, Paramount Syntex, SJP Ultrasonics and Dove Soft.

Together, the eight issues will raise around Rs 440 crore from the primary market.

The IPOs have different closing dates, with some issues closing on October 5 and others remaining open until October 6.

2.headline: Nityas Gems and Jewellery IPO: Issue subscribed 15% so far on Day 1; retail investors lead demand
2.heading: Nityas Gems and Jewellery IPO: Issue subscribed 15% so far on Day 1; retail investors lead demand
2.intro: Nityas Gems and Jewellery Limited opened its initial public offering (IPO) today, with the issue receiving 15 percent subscription, as of 1:45 pm on September 30, as per NSE data.
2.body:
Nityas Gems and Jewellery Limited opened its initial public offering (IPO) today, with the issue receiving 15 percent subscription, as of 1:45 pm on September 30, as per NSE data.

The Rs 108.42-crore IPO received bids for 21,07,400 shares against 1,44,56,000 shares on offer. Retail investors led the demand, with their portion subscribed 38 percent, while the non-institutional investors (NII) category was subscribed 7 percent.

In the grey market, Nityas Gems and Jewellery shares were trading around the issue price on the morning of September 30, according to InvestorGain.

Read Also: SRIT India IPO subscribed over 33x so far on Day 3; GMP rises to 27%

Grey market premiums are unofficial indicators of market sentiment and do not guarantee the actual listing price.

The company has fixed the IPO price band at Rs 70-75 per share. The public issue will remain open until October 5. The IPO comprises an entirely fresh issue of 1.44 crore equity shares, with no offer-for-sale component.

At the upper price band of Rs 75 per share, the company aims to raise Rs 108.42 crore through the issue.

The anchor book opened on September 29, a day ahead of the public subscription.

The IPO allotment is likely to be finalised on October 6, while trading in the company's equity shares is expected to commence on the bourses on October 8.

Check IPO News Here

Nityas Gems and Jewellery plans to utilise Rs 70 crore of the net IPO proceeds towards its working capital requirements. The remaining amount will be used for general corporate purposes.

The Gujarat-based company manufactures diamond-studded gold jewellery and operates primarily under a business-to-business (B2B) model, manufacturing jewellery products for retailers and wholesalers.

The company also has a direct-to-consumer (D2C) business through its subsidiary, Ayaani Diamonds and Jewellery, which operates an omnichannel retail business.
